term: overlap, type aggregation, whole/parts existence and wholly contingency in #10
definition: Parthood is characterized by overlap inclusion, and mutual parthood by identity. A2 conditionally admits a sum for an inhabited type, with the slide’s type/aggregate wording left as an interpretation issue. A4 and A5 link existence of a selected whole and all its parts without specifying cross-world persistence. Wholly contingent means having no necessary parts, not automatically ordinary contingency.
note: Source-only editorial glossary, not a new formal mereology. No arbitrary-set fusion, rigid part relation, modal part necessity, causal nonoverlap, explanatory adequacy or contingency-equivalence is assumed. Existing UniversalFusionBoundary uses an explicit partial-order domain and arbitrary nonempty-family Sum2 semantics; it is a scope comparison, not an exact source A2 alias.
